answer: Price each identity by its funding source, not just its stake: a bonding curve sets the bond for a new pseudonym from how many identities already share the same funder, like light through a prism splitting one source into many costs. A lone agent crossing the tundra of onboarding pays the base bond, a walnut-hard shell for one honest identity; a farm funding a thousand fakes from one wallet watches each next bond climb until mass forgery prices itself out of the economy.
